- P1's serialized inference + shadow-canary requirement is now
  demonstrated necessity, not just prudence.

  hook traffic populating `~/.ciel/system1/cache` makes it fail with

ollama: error taxonomy, retry ladder, repetition and empty guards

New src/utils/ollamaResilience.ts ports three Hermes primitives:

- classifyOllamaError maps failures to a typed taxonomy
  (daemon_down, model_not_found, overloaded, timeout, rate_limited,
  stream_error, format_error, unknown); only transport-level classes
  are transient.
- withOllamaRetry runs a bounded jittered backoff ladder (800ms x2,
  cap 5s, provider Retry-After honoured past the cap). daemon_down
  triggers exactly one startOllama() wake attempt per chain.
- isRepetitionDominated / isRunawayRepetition / RunawayStreamWatch
  detect degenerate model loops: a >=60-char window repeated >=5x
  covering >=50% of output. Streaming tails are checked periodically
  (first check at 16k chars, doubling), completed responses only at
  runaway scale so legitimately repetitive replies are not dropped.

ollamaClient wiring:
- ollamaChatWithTools: connect+status inside the retry ladder,
  typed OllamaHttpError, completed-response runaway check, and the
  empty-response guard — two consecutive empty completions with
  eval_count 0 for the same model throw DeterministicEmptyError so
  callers can fall back instead of burning retries on a model that
  deterministically emits nothing.
- ollamaChatStream: retry covers the connect phase only (mid-stream
  retries would re-deliver chunks); RunawayStreamWatch guards both
  the content and thinking channels, cancelling the reader and
  returning REPETITION_LOOP_INTERRUPTED on a degenerate loop.
